overall_assessment: Reviewed all 28 fetched-page entries (20 suspects and 8 controls), including all text supplied before explicit packet truncation markers, and all 6 additional failed-fetch entries. The 16 year flags concern later plans correctly excluded from the build; the earlier English control is also correctly excluded, the two short pages contain all available on-page content, and the two junk flags are false alarms from legitimate textbook login instructions. No missing plan sections, generic fallback plans, or material structural loss are demonstrated; retained pages have a minor recurring navigation label, while three legacy fetches fail on malformed URLs rather than establishing that the site has no page.

findings.description: All 11 retained fetched-page entries include this standalone table-of-contents navigation label between the facts box and plan sections, including all seven retained random controls. It is a small non-plan fragment; the packet otherwise shows that navigation and breadcrumbs are excluded successfully. This issue is not what triggered the two junk flags: their logg inn wording belongs to textbook-resource instructions.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The hiof selector in R/institution_config.R reads the entire #vrtx-fs-emne-content container without an exclude or post_fn for its internal table-of-contents label; page_fulltext() preserves that block.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a HiOF-specific post_fn that removes only complete lines exactly equal to Innholdsfortegnelse or Table of contents, retaining every plan heading and paragraph.

findings.description: Three of the six failed-fetch entries have literal spaces in the URL filename and fail with URL using bad/illegal format or missing URL. These requests do not establish whether a historical plan exists because the client cannot perform a valid request. The other three failures are HTTP 404s for very old offerings and are not reported as missing plans; no replacement page or valid historical-plan URL is demonstrated by this packet.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: add_course_url_hiof() in R/add_course_url.R interpolates the lowercased course code directly into a filename without percent-encoding spaces. resolve_urls_hiof_batch()/vortex_match_urls() can use this constructed URL when a listing folder was not read; older stored harvest URLs may also retain this pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Prefer URLs discovered from HiOF listings. When a constructed fallback is needed, percent-encode its UTF-8 filename component, including spaces, before requesting it; re-resolve or encode these stored malformed URLs and retry. Preserve a subsequent 404 or unresolved listing as unavailable rather than assuming an encoded URL proves a plan exists.
